options.label: J
options.action: Continue/implement lifestyle modifications and weight management at preconception; ensure routine preconception risk assessment has been completed (including OGTT already performed).

options.label: K

options.label: L

options.label: M

options.label: N
options.action: Guideline pathway not applicable: this guidance is focused on women with PCOS at preconception, during pregnancy, and postpregnancy.

options.label: O
